# Qlib

BenjaminAgent uses the published `pyqlib==0.9.7` package with LightGBM. The quantitative dependency versions are recorded in [requirements-quant.txt](../../backend/requirements-quant.txt).

Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/qlib

The upstream [MIT license](LICENSE) is retained here for attribution. See the [run guide](../../docs/en/run-guide.md) for installation and data prerequisites.
